evidence: Facility self sign-up (D14), shipped closed. 0086 ports main 0061-0063 (db49a0d, 46a173f, 08c906f) with this branch's adaptations and support's review, and runtime-grants.sql carries its grants for a later role bootstrap. What changes: identity.organization_applications gains approval_mode (NOT NULL DEFAULT 'admin_review', metadata-only) and three nullable review columns (self_service_reviewed_at, self_service_reviewed_by_account_id referencing auth.accounts, self_service_review_note; all set together, only on an approved self-service row), two partial indexes, and its 0046 reviewer check is replaced by main 0062's organization_applications_review_check_self_service; new definer commands submit_self_service_organization_application, public_get_organization_application, public_record_organization_cac_result, activate_self_service_provider_enrollment (wrapper of the owner-only activate_self_service_organization_application), the owner-only lapse helper, platform.consume_self_service_cac_quota(uuid,char,integer), admin_list_self_service_facilities and admin_review_self_service_facility; two new counter tables with forced RLS and no runtime privilege; three replaced functions keep their signatures, owners and grants: identity.submit_organization_application (0052's body plus the 24-hour lapse of an abandoned self-service application), platform.prune_verification_quotas (0049's body plus the two new tables) and platform.control_enabled (0040's body plus the key provider_self_service_enabled); platform.control_settings's key CHECK is replaced with the six live keys plus the new one, and the new control is seeded OFF (FORCE row-level security lifted for that one insert and restored at once, as main 0098 does, since the table has no INSERT policy). Nothing is dropped except the two replaced CHECK constraints; no applied migration is rewritten; no existing grant is removed. Preconditions refuse to run (in the release's dry run, so nothing changes) unless exactly one reviewer check and one control-key check exist, both control lists name exactly the six live keys, and the prune deletes exactly the 0049 tables. Proof that no existing closed application can fail the new review check: the 0046 check admits a closed row only with a reviewer and a review time and either a review reason of 8+ characters or a NULL reason (a NULL check result passes); the new check requires reviewed_at and a coalesced reason of 8+ characters and, for admin_review rows (all existing rows), a reviewer; so exactly the closed rows with a NULL review_reason pass the old check and fail the new one. Every command that closes an application writes a reason of 8+ characters, so only a direct write could leave one, and 0086 counts closed rows without a reason of 8+ characters, reviewer or review time first and raises a clear exception if any exist (shown on a copy holding one such row). Read-only preflight before merging: select count(*) from identity.organization_applications where status in ('approved','rejected') and (review_reason is null or length(btrim(review_reason)) < 8 or reviewed_at is null or reviewed_by_account_id is null) must be 0. Backward compatibility and rollback: the previous Identity (57a94db) calls none of the new commands; its governed intake still inserts admin_review rows by default; its governed approve and reject always name a reviewer and a reason of 8+ characters, which the new check admits; the replaced governed submit, prune and control_enabled keep their signatures and answers for every input the previous code sends (the governed submit additionally lapses a self-service row that a newer Identity left unactivated for 24 hours, which only exists once the control has been opened); the admin console's control list returns seven rows, and the previous Identity's DTO cannot change the new key, which stays off. The new suite test/database/provider-self-service-rollback.integration.sql runs the previous Identity's own SQL text (governed intake, admin list, get, CAC record with the application_cac quota, approve and reject, the applicant's completion start, verify, current and complete, the existing-organization CAC binding match for a facility that signed itself up, the control list and change, the guard's control reads, the prune) as hid_identity_api_runtime on the new schema. Gate: with the control off, submit and activation raise 55000 PLATFORM_CONTROL_DISABLED:provider_self_service_enabled and write nothing; the control is read from Identity's accountless context exactly as the security guard's portal check already reads it in production; under an owner that cannot bypass row-level security the gate stays closed (55000 PLATFORM_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE). Locks until commit, measured with pg_locks on PostgreSQL 16: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on identity.organization_applications and SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on auth.accounts (the reviewer foreign key) from the first statements; ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on platform.control_settings only in the control section, which is the last statements of the file (4.5 ms of 38 ms on an empty database). Tests: built in production order (0001-0072, role bootstrap with the 0072-era runtime-grants.sql, then 0073-0086 with apply-migrations.mjs), the same followed by a role bootstrap with this runtime-grants.sql, and in new-installation order (0001-0086, then role bootstrap): all 39 suites pass in each (16 in services/ehr-api/database/tests, unchanged, and 23 in services/ehr-api/test/database, 6 of them new); the 6 new suites fail on a database built to 0085, where the other 33 pass; the new suites catch each of 23 deliberate defects in 0086. Under a non-superuser NOBYPASSRLS definer owner (the rehearsal's owner swap) every new suite passes. The plan and dry run on a 0085 database list and roll back only 0086; a dry run of 0084-0086 in one transaction on a 0083 database succeeds. services/ehr-api/scripts/test-staging-schema-upgrade.mjs now rehearses production's order as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator (baseline, role bootstrap with the baseline runtime-grants.sql, dry run, migrations, then requires that a bootstrap with this runtime-grants.sql changes no runtime privilege) and passes; it fails without the seed's RLS lift and without either copy of the grants. scripts/tuf-staging-migration-rehearsal.mjs passes unchanged. reviewed_by is left empty for the owner.
